description: This Java class 'HelloController' is a Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints such as a welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info. It also uses Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints for a pet data management backend.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/' and returns a welcome message.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/docs' and redirects to Swagger UI, preserving request scheme/host/port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/health' and returns the application health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/api/info' and returns application information.
